intrinsic_skills.skill_description: 行动：从场上所有弃牌堆中选择一张装备牌返回手牌。

skills.skill_description: 行动：对一个目标造成2点伤害。
行动：对射程内的最多3个怪物各造成5点伤害
skills.window_prompt: "钉子炸弹": 选择攻击目标
skills.content:
actions.consume_action(player, 1)
var list = event.targets
for i in list:
	actions.damage(i, 5, player)

skills.skill_description: 被动：当你抓取一张怪物卡后，弃掉此装备并对该怪物造成7点伤害。
行动：所有玩家造成的伤害增加1，直到其回合结束。
行动：消耗1点燃料，对一个目标造成5点伤害。
skills.content:
actions.consume_action(player, 1)
var weapon = player.get_equipment("blowtorch")
actions.consume_charge(player, weapon, 1)
actions.damage(target, 5, player, "weapon_attack", weapon.equipment_card)

skills.skill_description: 行动：将任一玩家移动到任一已展示的地图块。
skills.window_prompt: "启动汽车": 选择要移动的玩家

skills.skill_description: 行动：放置在射程内的任一武器上，那张武器额外造成1点伤害。
skills.content:
actions.consume_action(player, 1)
actions.add_mark_skill(target.equipment_card, "upgrade_damage_plus_1", 1, "", "升级", "该武器额外造成1点伤害", true)
actions.mount_sub_skill(player, "upgrade_damage")
actions.mount_sub_skill(player, "upgrade_clear_mark_discard")
actions.mount_sub_skill(player, "upgrade_clear_mark_unequip")

skills.skill_description: 行动：消耗1枚弹药，对一个目标造成2点伤害。
skills.content:
actions.consume_action(player, 1)
var weapon = player.get_equipment("pistol")
actions.consume_charge(player, weapon, 1)
actions.damage(target, 2, player, "weapon_attack", weapon.equipment_card)

skills.skill_description: 行动：从1个地图块上移除所有怪物标记。
行动：将一张装备牌装备给另一名玩家，然后你抓取一张牌。
skills.window_prompt: "阅读使用说明": 选择要给出的装备
skills.content:
var _selected = await player.choose_target(1, {"filter_target": "return target.is_player() && target != player", "filter_target_range": "medium"}, "\"阅读使用说明\": 选择装备目标玩家")
if _selected.is_empty():
	EventSystem.cancel(event)
	return
var target2 = _selected[0]
actions.consume_action(player, 1)
var _card = target.equipment_card
await player.unequip(target)
await target2.equip(_card)
actions.draw(player, 1)

skills.skill_description: 被动：每次你受到伤害时，消耗1枚弹药，自动炮塔对伤害来源造成4点伤害。
skills.filter: return event.source != null && event.source != player && player.get_charge_count("auto_turret") > 0

skills.skill_description: 行动：完全装填射程内的任一武器。
skills.window_prompt: "自制子弹": 选择装填的武器
